operational_source_of_truth: Google Ads/Shopify/GitHub current API readback; user explicit scoped authorization for writes

constraints.rule: Only campaign ADD_TO_CART~WEBSITE biddable=false was approved/applied in B-min; Purchase remains biddable. No inferred budget, other campaign, account goal or status edit is authorized.
If PMax purchase-only experiment is active, check cross-experiment customer-facing impact and require explicit change approval plus new measurement boundary. Advisory, not remote technical lock.
Recommendation repository is READ_ONLY_REFERENCE_ONLY; no commits, dispatch, publishing or scheduler changes until revised user instruction.

G2X stays paused until actual creative approval/limited, verified fulfillment and separate spend authorization. 175 CNY campaign-total and intended CPC 4.11 CNY are historical config, not new permission.
Exclude four merchant-paid QA orders from validated consumer orders, CAC, conversion and ROAS; preserve separate accounting. Unknown orders remain UNKNOWN until positive independent evidence.

Before proposing a new ecommerce event sender, inventory ALL existing Google & YouTube, custom, theme, GTM and checkout sources; verify actual requests, same-session identity, receiving GA4, and consent. No duplicate add_to_cart sender without independently proved gap and approval.

Before write verify raw editable baseline, after write verify a pre-agreed canonicalized representation. If post-write SHA mismatches authorized expected form and platform wrapper was not pre-agreed, stop and roll back before further testing.
Prior dry-run success and publish_blocks=[] are not Shopify publication; current snapshot publishing_enabled=false, state applications=[] and feedback learning disabled.

Do not subtract Shopify sessions-with-cart from GA4 add_to_cart events; keep Google Ads attributed conversions, app placement impressions, network impressions, rejected bot classifications and cost units distinct.

Agent-reported deployment/rollback UTC timestamps conflict with known chat wall clock; preserve verbatim as disputed and independently validate original ISO timestamps before putting on immutable official timeline.

review_policy: Reconcile snapshots with actual API state before any operation; never treat this file as standing authorization.
